title: Texans risked a late Jaguars' field goal before halftime by kicking into end zone

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Texans risked a late Jaguars' field goal before halftime by kicking into end zone
sources.description: Last Sunday in London, the Eagles opted to put a kickoff in play with eight seconds left in the fourth quarter of a game against the Jaguars.
